description: Japan government bond (JGB) yield curve for one day: all 15 benchmark tenors (1Y-10Y, 15Y, 20Y, 25Y, 30Y, 40Y) in percent, from the Ministry of Finance Japan. Omit date for the latest business day. A weekend, holiday or not-yet-published day returns found:false with the nearest published days and `nearest_prior`, the latest earlier curve with its own date.

date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD (business days only). Default: latest.
